name: Faster head tracking
about: Stock FIRM sends a head pose every 40 ms, only steps the orientation filter on every 4th IMU sample (240 Hz / 4 = 60 Hz) and smooths the result with alpha 0.1. These knobs are the literals behind that. See docs/18-firm-walkthrough.md, Head tracking pipeline.

settings.name: tx_ms
settings.what: period of 'air motion tx timer' in ms (movs r0,#imm in FUN_00cab53c)

settings.name: decimate
settings.what: fusion steps every (N+1)th IMU sample (cmp r3,#imm in FUN_00c68924)

settings.name: alpha
settings.what: exponential smoother blend factor (literal pool of FUN_00c68924)
